reviews.review:
I thought it will be small, funny game to kill time, but I was so wrong.
- character creation is like from doll makers from 2000s: you need to click a ton of times to get colour you want and it also looks random. Character has pixel glitches visible with naked eye and rarely will be centered on the screen: few times it was at bottom covered by icons or in upper side of screen.
- music wasn't playing even with volume on in the middle and sound effects were still on even when I turned them off
-cost of upgrades aren't shown, so you don't know how many pearls you need to get one you want.
-key binding isn't clear: it says "keyboard", but it also includes "mouse buttons"
-even on easiest levels suddenly spike difficulty goes quickly to insane levels where you don't see what kills you [instead of slowly introducing enemies it throws everything at once].

All in all, it's a slop. Flash games had more playability and were at last fun. It's my first in 10 years game I asked for refund.
